pages.title: Resonance Probe
pages.text: A handheld instrument that reads the four virtual-particle resonances of the Quantum Foam where you stand. It hums at different pitches depending on what the vacuum is doing, and its needle never settles.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Quantum Foam I needed to know which virtual particles were bubbling up where. A spectral analyzer tuned by a qubit and a Planck shard gave me a probe that could read the foam's resonances.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Thermodynamics of Information.
